FireJump branches on SystemDef.message_id (payload +0x68 / SystemDef +0x92) != -1, showing the buoy instead of the generic "Entering the <system>" text.

name: NoSys_NoOp_00467e60
comment: Stubbed Windows replacement for the Mac _FadeWhiteIn display call in Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore's hold-active top block (0x0044aa70). The original Windows release is a bare RET, so the hold builds up no white; the port delivers the Mac behaviour instead of the stub: NovaTravel_Tick's kHold branch latches one kFadeIn request when (progress-55)*5 becomes positive; NoSys_NoOp_00467e60 itself has no port call. Cited at the 0x00467e60 build-up comment.

name: Ship_CanMaintainCloakState
comment: NovaAiShip_CanMaintainCloakState: disabled/fire-restriction rejection, last ModType 17 match wins, fuel nibble 0x00f0 and shield nibble 0x0f00 vs current resources (BUGFIX(original): the original reads those nibbles from the matched ModType word, so the fuel gate is always active and the shield gate never fires; the gated path uses ModVal), and the player-only tail (ship_instance_id == 0 && ai_station_hold_timer > 0 -> false unless ShipClass.flags_secondary bit 0x0400, Bible sh\xefp Flags2 'AI ships will cloak when hyperspacing', also applied to the player). Missing class is treated as flag-clear (safe-fail).

name: Ship_OnShipCloakStateEntered
comment: NovaAi_OnShipCloakStateEntered: visibility-threshold early-out; player cloak-enter cue (snd 381) when ship_instance_id == 0 and cloak_transition_latch < 1; fade/latch normalization; ModType-17 shield-drop with shield > 0. The g_player_status_panel_dirty latch is implied by the immediate-mode HUD.

name: Ship_OnShipCloakStateCleared
comment: NovaAi_OnShipCloakStateCleared: visibility-threshold gate; player cloak-clear cue (snd 380) when ship_instance_id == 0 and cloak_transition_latch > -1; negative transition latch / latch clear.

name: NovaText_FormatDateString

DatePrefix/DateSuffix (char resource +0x13a/+0x14a) are populated by the new-pilot ApplyCharacterTemplate into GameState.date_prefix/date_suffix and passed by the mission-text callers and the main-menu status panel; stock .Trader renders with the trailing " NC". See docs/char_resource_format.md. Token order and suffix selection verified against 0x00468450.

name: Stellar_FormatElapsedTravelTime

Used by the mission-text <DL> token (active-slot arm: runtime-flags deadline; deadline==today expands to the empty init string) and the arrival-message elapsed-time format. TODO(decomp): the offer-row <DL> arm reads the mission target-resolution table (dates not tracked); elapsed-days params 3/4 are ignored by the original body too. DatePrefix/DateSuffix are shared with 0x00468450 and populated (see that row). See docs/char_resource_format.md.

name: Ship_IsShipDisabled
comment: The predicate doubles as the disabled check everywhere (weapons, jump engage 0x0044c1a3, collapse gate 0x0044b037, targeting scans). Ported as NovaAiShip_IsDisabled with all four original sources: derelict-govt 0x800; mission-fleet ShipGoal-5 active with the runtime ship-objective-complete latch (MisnRuntimeFlags+0x02, Ghidra's special_ship_attacking misnomer) clear and boarded_target_latch clear; the non-player stellar-approach exemption (XOR AL,AL at 0x00468856); and the armor gate armor*100.0f < Ship_ComputeShipMaxArmor (0x004637a0) * (33.333 @0x575808 / 10.0 @0x5757f8) with capability flags 0x10. No remaining TODO.

name: Ship_CanPlayerHaveMoreEscorts

name: Weapon_CanFireWeaponBank

Return is a plain bool in AL (not a bitfield; FNSTSW AH residue).

name: System_HasUsableTravelDestination
comment: NovaSystem_HasUsableTravelDestination: scans nav_defs[0..3] for a stellar with travel_flags 0x20 clear and availability_flags 0x3000 clear. Bounds-guarded forms of the original's four-slot loop and both flag tests; no remaining gap.

name: Mission_IsStellarValidRandomDestination
comment: It is not physical travel reachability but the EV Nova Bible random destination rule (destination must be far from the offering system AND guaranteed to persist across system swapping). Ported in full: out-of-range candidate -> true, !is_defined -> false, same-system and one-jump-adjacent rejection, then a walk of the candidate system's visibility-parent twin chain requiring the candidate to be a nav default in every system (SystemDef.nav_stellar_ids, via NovaSystem_ResolveDiscoverySlot). Wired into StellarLocatorEligible (shared by the 0x0043d510 rejection sampling and the 0x00441b40 existence sanity check) with the chain-only reference (-1) used by Misn_ResolveMissionStellarLocators 0x0043c3e0 and Mission_CheckMissionShipInteractionEligibility 0x00441b40; the per-target anchor (Mission_ResolveMissionStellarTargets 0x0043d240 param_2 = ai_secondary_target_slot/first nav) is honored, and the original rejection-sampling pick loop is ported (see 0x0043D510). Remaining divergence: the 0x00441b40 sanity selector does not consume the selection RNG in the port.

name: NovaUi_DrawSystemFactionConflictStatus
comment: Shared NovaUi_SystemFactionConflictStatusText serves the starmap and in-flight Player Info page; exact CrimeTol/reputation ladder, first-three-nav hazard override, xenophobic N/A arm, and localized STR# 0x86 lookup. Callers apply the separate 0x00468af0 usable-destination gate. Signed-overflow guards reduce to plain comparisons for shipped positive tolerances; the menu has an equivalent display wrapper.

name: NovaUi_DrawCombatRankLabel
comment: MenuCombatRankLabel and NovaPlayerInfo_CombatRankIndex share the exact rank semantics: 0 points selects index 0, any positive score selects index 1, and 100/200/400/800/1600/3200/6400/12800/25600 advance through indices 2..10. Focused boundary regression in player_info_window_test.cpp.

name: Ship_ComputeTradeInValue
comment: Base ship trade-in: per-step truncation-toward-zero (FIST+residual, not round-nearest) sum of 25% of the current ship class base_cost (ShipClassDef +0x58) plus 50% of each owned non-persistent outfit's mass-scaled Outfit::PurchasePrice (persistent = outfit flag 0x0004, loader-cached at OutfitDef +0x378; rank outfits 0x2000 still count), clamped >=0. Player-only. Callers scale twice through Outfit_ComputeScaledPurchasePrice.

name: Weapon_HasMatchingWeaponAmmoCarried
comment: Ported inline as PlayerCarriesMatchingWeaponAmmo: player bank scan by ammo_type, preserving the first-armed-mode-99-bank early-return quirk.

name: NovaAudio_PlaySpatialByDistance
comment: NovaWeapon_ComputeSpatialFireGain preserves rounded displacement, directional 722500/40000 inverse-square falloff, extent/8 clamps, and mono averaging. SDL playback replaces NovaAudio_QueueCenteredSound; tracked callsites preserve original widths: ordinary NPC/linked fire 4, stellar/carrier fire and ordinary player fire 5, player beams/secondary fire 6, impacts 6, and destruction 5. Master volume remains multiplicative with spatial gain.

name: ShipClass_HasPlayerBayCapacityFor
comment: NovaShipClass_HasPlayerBayCapacityFor: bay resolution (direct class match, escort_type clone-family fallback, ModType-3 fighter-bay outfit), occupancy = loaded secondary or owned count, capacity = WeaponDef.max_ammo (Bible MaxAmmo, payload +0x6c) x mounted or outfit Max, + active behavior-5 fighter count. Wired into the mode-8 dock player arm. Player board command (0x0045a3d0) recovery arms and the AI mode-8 dock arm are wired; the UI purchase gate (0x00491950) callsite remains unwired.

name: Player_ComputeFleetCargoCapacity
comment: Full 0x00469760: player hull capacity (16-bit truncation mirrored) plus every active, undestroyed behavior-6 escort attached to the player (squad_leader 0), not in a mission fleet, whose class InherentAI < 3 (freighter/civilian), adding class cargo_holds; clamped to 32000. Hired Cargo Drones augment the fleet total.

name: Player_TransferCargoAndJunkToEscortByRatio
comment: Ports the capacity-ratio transfer for player/escort slots, including the inline unclamped same-system fleet denominator, destroyed-recipient exception, original slot-zero cargo overwrite and junk subtraction behavior, truncation, clamps, and derived-state invalidation. Remaining: eager Outfit_RecomputeOutfitDerivedState side effects are represented by lazy stat-cache invalidation.

name: NovaInput_IsCommandActiveWithGameplayGuards
comment: Partial port as NovaInput_IsCommandActive: resolves the command id to the bound key via the shared key-binding table, then tests the held key (the original's g_player_key_bindings -> DAT_0086e098 snapshot path). TODO(decomp(0x00469ca0)): the DAT_00596d3c modal/gameplay-suspended guard and the five-entry g_panel_suppressed_commands list are not modelled; callers that need them still gate themselves.

name: Stellar_ExtractTravelFlagConnectiveValue
comment: Ported as StellarTradesClass: the six 3-bit trade-class lanes at flags bits 28-30, 24-26, ... 8-10; nonzero lane = traded. Bit-level decode verified against the 0x00469d30 switch. Also ported exactly (lane values 1/2/4, not just nonzero) as Stellar_TradeConnective in trade_center.cpp for the exchange price scale. Both call forms are exact; no remaining gap.

name: NovaUi_RebuildShipyardAvailabilityList
comment: Partial clean-room availability list: decoded stellar base/special tech gates, valid-resource and BuyRandom-zero filtering, Require and availability expressions, equal-weight suppression, and descending stable ordering. name: Outfit_RebuildAvailableOutfitListForTravelStellar
comment: Partial clean-room availability list: decoded stellar base/special tech gates, valid-resource and owned visibility handling, Require and availability expressions, display-weight-zero inclusion, equal-weight suppression, and descending stable ordering. name: Player_HasAnyCargoMissionOrJunk
comment: Checks the six player cargo bins, active carried mission cargo with valid type/quantity, and all junk counts; deliberately does not inspect owned outfits. Wired into the Player Info cargo summary path.

name: Ship_ComputeShipTotalCargoCapacity
comment: Port as Ship_ComputeShipTotalCargoCapacity: class Holds (ShipClassDef.cargo_holds +0x0 / shp payload 0x00) plus, for every owned outfit, owned_count * ModType-2 (cargo space) ModVal per slot (16-bit product truncation mirrored). Player baseline for Player_ComputeFleetCargoCapacity (0x00469760). ModType 2 is cargo space, not mass (disassembly-verified).

name: Player_ComputeRemainingCargoSpace
comment: Full 0x0046a7c0 formula: ship capacity minus carried, with escort-freighter holds absorbing bins/junk overflow before mission cargo and any remainder are charged to the ship. Single-ship branch is not clamped (callers clamp; e.g. 0x0049c050). The escort branch activates because Player_ComputeFleetCargoCapacity (0x00469760) models escort freighters.

name: NovaUi_RedrawGameplayViewportAndRadar
comment: The synchronous gameplay viewport + radar redraw is expressed structurally: SpaceflightView::Draw rebuilds the world each frame and HudRenderer::DrawRadarPanel (0x0045d600) redraws the radar. The original's saved-backdrop ClearSurface14/DrawContext fill and the g_is_system_transition_active skip of SpriteWorld_RenderLayers are preserved (transition fills the space tint only). No offscreen surface exists in the SDL port.

name: NovaAudio_QueueCenteredSound
comment: SdlAudio::Play queues exactly one centered SDL voice and carries the original second argument as priority_width (minimum 1), rather than replaying it as a repeat count. Direct callsites preserve verified ranks: menu focus/intro 10, menu reveal/hyperspace 0x32, combat chatter 0x0f, ordinary transition cues 1. SDL stream conversion replaces the original descriptor/backend plumbing.

name: NovaAudio_PreStageJumpSoundBySeconds
comment: The warp-up cue is not pre-staged by seconds in the port: it plays on the hold-begin latch (NovaTravel_Tick) and the fire waits on the live voice count, subsume the staging. The duration-scale folding is ported inline at the play call: the original stores 65536/multiplier, while SDL receives the chassis multiplier as playback speed (0.91..2.08) via NovaTravel_PlayerJumpDurationMultiplier. Remaining: the original's seconds-based pre-stage scheduling is not modelled.

name: NovaAudio_UpdateCenteredGainFromPreference
comment: Maps sound_volume * 8 through the original [0,0x100] centered-level clamp and Audio_AllocateVoiceSlot's 0x80 per-channel cap, then normalizes the backend's level * sample >> 7 scale for SDL master gain.

name: Ship_GetScannerStrength

name: Registration_SpawnLicenseEnforcer

Rating producer ported (NovaFrame_AddCombatRatingPoints, collision.cpp); clean-room draws from GameState.rng not the original LCG.

Caller's non-player branch (NovaRandom_Range(2)==0 bypasses the gate) is modelled; clean-room uses GameState.rng instead of the global LCG.

Weighted distribution verified (weights 10/20/70 -> ~20/38/142/200 across 2000 draws).

name: Ship_ComputeIonizationDecayRate
comment: Functional reconstruction complete: NPC ships return the live class base (payload +0x36a via the 0x004BD3C0 converter); the player uses a dedicated lazy cache (GameState.cached_ionization_decay_rate, Ghidra g_player_cached_ionization_decay_rate/DAT_007356ac) valid while >=0 (negative/NaN recompute), reset to -1 by InvalidateDerivedStatCaches at every stat-invalidation site. ModType 39 dissipators accumulate in the documented (ModVal*0.01_double)*owned + total order with per-slot float rounding. ACCEPTED DIVERGENCE: intermediates are double (53-bit) while the original runs x87 extended (64-bit) on this entry path (PE_EntryPoint 0x008713e0 -> CRT_StartupMain -> FNINIT/FUN_00881060, CW 0x037F; no 0x027F in the image), e.g. base=1.0/val=-100/owned=1 ~ -2.08e-17 vs 0.0; treated as a platform-precision tradeoff, not bit-exact and not an original bug; see docs/x87_precision.md. The caller decay/clamp path is ported (spaceflight.cpp / spaceflight_player_state.cpp via NovaShip_UpdateIonizationCharge); the float-vs-double tick scale remains an accepted divergence on those rows.

name: Ship_GetIonizationIntensity
comment: Fully reconstructed as NovaOutfit_GetIonizationIntensity with the capacity arm inline in NovaOutfit_ComputeIonizationCapacity (the NPC-only class path remains NovaShip_IonizationIntensity in spaceflight_movement.cpp). NPC returns class ionization_capacity (payload +0x36c, sign-extended int16) with no cache; player adds each owned ModType 40 (ion absorber) mod_val*owned (integer, no 0.01 scale) across all four effect slots and caches the float total in GameState.cached_ionization_capacity (Ghidra DAT_007356a8, renamed g_player_cached_ionization_capacity) valid while >=0 (0.0 is valid), reset at Outfit_RecomputeOutfitDerivedState 0x0046d507; returns 0 for capacity <=0. ACCEPTED PRECISION DIVERGENCE: the original stores the rounded float cache but keeps dividing by the unrounded x87 accumulator on the first uncached call, while the port divides by the rounded float immediately. See docs/x87_precision.md.

name: System_GetEffectiveMurkPercent
comment: NovaSystem_GetEffectiveMurkPercent: max(SystemDef.murk,0) + sum over owned outfits of owned_count*ModVal for every ModType 0x1c (MurkMod) slot, clamped [0,100]. Computed on demand each Draw instead of cached in g_distance_intensity_scale (the original's Outfit_RecomputeOutfitDerivedState cache); the render fog and NPC glow cap read it.

name: Weapon_GetShotImpactVariant
comment: Spawn path mirrors the high-confidence Flags2 0x1000 -> ShotState.impact_variant conversion; the helper is not yet split into a one-to-one clean-room function.

Muzzle bearing derives the displayed frame from heading (original reads sprite+0x68) -- TODO(decomp) equivalence note. Wired into NovaWeapon_SpawnProjectile.

Geometry moved to ShipClass.muzzle_* decoded at scenario load: X/Y ExitType families use shan +0x48/+0x50 +16g+2q (the loader interleaves each pair); Z uses +0x90+8g+2q; scales 0x88/0x8a/0x8c/0x8e *0.01, <=0 clamped to 1.0.

TODO(decomp): the sprite/frame rect-vs-viewport arm used to cull per-mission-slot reaction updates is not ported (the clean-room Ship has no sprite-rect model; see 0x00443c60).

Rank arm byte-verified against ränk runtime +0x14/+0x18 (payload +0x0e/+0x12); DecodeRank field order matches the ResForge TMPL and the salary/contribute consumers.

Wired at its 0x00405590 caller: the state-4 Flags2 0x0002 standoff envelope scales the (short) reach by 0.85 (0x5750b8) and halves it for a disabled target.

comment: NovaOutfit_HasFastJumpCapability: class Flags2 0x0020 OR any of an outfit's four ModTypes 0x25 (37, kFastJump); player (ship_instance_id 0) scans owned inventory (positive count, ModVal irrelevant), NPCs scan the class default loadout. Four direct callsite equivalents: Ship_UpdateShipAiState state-2 brake (0x004060d1) and state-3 attack jump-departure arm (0x00406720), and Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore kBrake stop gate (0x0044c4db) and kHold damp (0x0044c726). The fifth Ghidra caller, the player mode-3 map-bearing re-aim gate (0x0044ed32), is gated on ai_station_hold_timer > 0 (DAT_00575538 = 0.0, verified at 0x0044ed1d) and therefore runs during the engaged brake/hold alignment, not in an armed pre-engage state; the port satisfies it through the unconditional engaged-hold alignment. The verified timer gate is high confidence; port equivalence of the surrounding auto-turn timing (notably a possible one-frame entry offset) was not established (see 0x0044C18A row and docs/player_hyperspace.md).

name: Ship_ShipsShareSquadRoot
comment: Implemented as SharesSquadRoot, with the public NovaShip_ShipsShareSquadRoot wrapper (src/game/collision.cpp) so Shot_HandleShot's target-chain arm can reuse the exact chain semantics. Walks both squad_leader_ship_slot chains to their roots and compares; bounded loop tolerates malformed cycles (original is unbounded). Stored as 80% because the wrapping behaviour for inactive roots is a documented divergence.

name: Outfit_RecomputeOutfitDerivedState
comment: Clean-room hook is NovaOutfit_RecomputeOutfitDerivedState (see docs/outfit_derived_state.md for the two-mechanism model). Modelled: stat-cache invalidation (lazy Ship_Compute* sentinel equivalent, GameState.stat_cache_valid), fleet-overflow scaling of the six ordinary cargo bins by capacity/(cargo+junk), negative cargo-bin/junk clamps, jamming_score reset, player cloak-latch reset (+0xC91C/1E/20), recently_hit_timer=-1.0, mining-scoop arm (NovaOutfit_RefreshPlayerMiningScoopActive), owned ModType 0x2c/0x30 government latches (Government.reinforcement_inhibited +0x82 / iff_scrambler_active +0x83, g_player_reinforcement_inhibit_all), and policy_flags clear/rebuild from active ranks. 14 direct callers + 5 interior Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore/Stellar_HandleStellarEntryAndExit sites; several port sites still set stat_cache_valid=false directly. TODO(decomp): license clamp, junk flags, carried-bomb class+timer. (The murk distance-intensity cache is instead computed on demand by NovaSystem_GetEffectiveMurkPercent; see docs/system_murk_rendering.md.) Contraband-scan candidate latches DAT_007356cc/DAT_007356cd are rebuilt by NovaOutfit_RefreshContrabandScanLatches (called from this recompute). g_playerInventoryAndLoadoutDirty after a scan fine is only the NovaUi_RefreshGameplayPanels (0x0045d320) cargo-HUD redraw latch, not a recompute trigger, so the latches correctly stay clear until a later real inventory mutation.

Deliberately distinct from Stellar_ShipHasGravityShielding (0x0046e120): the NPC flags_secondary 0x40 gate and the ModType 0x26 (inertial dampener)/0x29 (gravity resistance) outfits do NOT grant crash immunity. The original caches the player-outfit roll in DAT_007356c6; the clean-room recomputes per call, behaviorally identical while the inventory is unchanged (the original's cache is invalidated on outfit change), so the only divergence is the cache itself.

comment: NovaResource_AccessCharacterBlockByKey: name-keyed lookup over the ch\x9ar archive family (ResourceData_FindByKey + materialize semantics) backing SetupFrames/InitializePlayerState; in-memory registry merge and block locking/initializer slice not reconstructed (needs a .plt writer, TODO(decomp))

name: ResourceArchive_OpenRez
comment: ParseArchive reconstructs the BRGR descriptor-table and big-endian resource.map parse into entries/records.

name: Dialog_ParseItemList
comment: DITL item parser reimplemented as NovaResource_LoadDialogItems: BE count, rect/type bytes, per-type tail skip, even align; validates the 8 docked Spaceport buttons

name: UiWindow_CreateFromDialogResource
comment: Ported on SDL: DLOG+DITL load and authored window-local geometry; placement is selected during the interaction frame without mutating renderer state during resource loading. Original window-surface allocation is replaced by SDL compositing.

name: UiWindow_RunInteractionLoop
comment: Ported per-frame modal loop: background redraw, scoped contained dialog placement, matching inverse mouse mapping and window-point probe bounds. Original window-stack compositing is replaced by SDL; existing keyboard/default-control and callback gaps remain.

name: UiWindow_Draw
comment: Ported control drawer: bevel triples Static text (type 8) wraps via WrapDescriptionLines with real Ascent/LineHeight metrics, top-aligned and clipped to the item rect; edit text/selection/caret clip to the field rect inset by 3 (0x004bcd30/ NovaText_DrawText semantics). The item pass saves and restores the renderer clip through util::RenderClipScope.

name: NovaMouse_GetWindowRelativePosition
comment: Mouse minus current window record origin. 0% unported.

name: NovaList_Create
comment: List-control constructor (rect, row pitch, row count, scrollbar-enabled flag) modelled as the NovaListControl constructor (nova_list_control.cpp), the clean-room counterpart of the native list control. The original's text buffer, per-row offset table and draw-callback fields (+0x28/+0x2c/+0x1c) are not reproduced: the dialogs own std::vector row text and paint it through NovaUi_DrawListRow. Provisional; only the fields the mission lists consume are modelled.

name: NovaList_ScrollSelectionIntoView
comment: Scroll-selected-row-into-view modelled as NovaListControl::EnsureVisible: no-op when the whole list fits, otherwise scroll by (selected - current offset) so the row is just inside. Converges on the same offset as the original's minimum-delta scroll.

name: NovaList_HitTestPoint
comment: Point-to-row mapping modelled as NovaListControl::RowAt and the scrollbar arm as NovaListScrollbarHitTest: content clicks map to (y - list.top)/pitch + scroll, the 15px strip classifies arrow caps / above- and below-thumb page bands / thumb; on-thumb clicks are a no-op (the original has no drag). TODO(decomp): the +0x38 last-click 60 Hz tick stamp is not modelled.

name: NovaList_GetRowRect
comment: Row rectangle modelled as NovaListControl::RowRect: list.top + (row - scroll) * pitch, list-local x/width; matches the original's FUN_004b8d80 + Rect_Offset composition.

name: NovaList_ScrollByRows
comment: Scroll-by-rows modelled as NovaListControl::ScrollRows: offset += delta, clamped to [0, row_count - visible_rows] with visible_rows = floor(height/pitch), exactly the original's integer clamp.

name: NovaList_Draw
comment: List redraw modelled as NovaUi_DrawListScrollbar plus the dialogs' clipped row loop: row rectangles and per-row fills/labels via NovaUi_DrawListRow, then a 15px scrollbar with frame, trough, up/down chevrons and a proportional thumb (no drag; on-thumb clicks are inert). TODO(decomp): the native grip/hash lines and exact thumb rounding.

name: NovaApp_Run
comment: NovaApp_Run app entry

name: FUN_004d4480
comment: NovaTime_GetSharewareDayCounter: (UTC now - DAT_00870900)/0x15180 + 1 with a 0x5a floor for pre-release clocks. Not reimplemented (shareware trial state deliberately absent from the clean-room).

name: NovaAudio_FillVoiceSlotDescriptor
comment: Runs inline in SdlAudio::Play: one voice, fixed 1.0 playback rate, centered mono gain, priority_width preserved. SDL stream setup replaces original backend descriptors and owner-link allocation.

name: Audio_AllocateVoiceSlot
comment: SDL replacement preserves the 16-slot ordered insertion policy: scan until incoming width and effective level both meet/exceed an entry, insert there, evict the final entry when full, or reject when none qualifies. DirectSound handles and callback fields are deliberately replaced by RAII SDL streams.

name: NovaAudio_CountActiveByHandle
comment: SdlAudio::CountActiveByKey counts draining voices with matching resource key. Original also accepts owner-link ids and handle 0 as count-all; neither form is needed by reconstructed callsites.

name: NovaAudio_UnregisterCallbacks
comment: SdlAudio::StopByKey clears all active streams matching a resource key, matching gameplay cancellation behavior. Original callback invocation and owner-link matching are not modelled.

name: NovaSound_ExpandIma4Samples
comment: snd sample expansion (v+0x80) dup quirk; decoded in NovaSound_DecodePayload

name: NovaSound_DecodePayload
comment: snd payload decoder (NovaSound_DecodePayload): format-1 'ima4' extended + 'NONE' 8-bit + format-2 'NONE' 8-bit sub-formats; covers menu blips (600/601/602/603) and weapon fire sounds (snd 200..235, slot->200+slot); other AIFC/16-bit sub-forms still unsupported

name: Path_GetModulePathMac
comment: Full path -> Mac-style "<drive>:a:b" prefix string. Unported.

name: FUN_004fca30
comment: Endian-converting 36-byte PixMap-header copy is represented inline in Resource_LoadPictAsImage by direct big-endian field reads (including pixelSize/cmpCount and the 32->24-bit demotion input); destination-copy and pmTable handle semantics are not applicable to the file-based parser

name: FUN_004fcac0
comment: Row expander: 1-bit MSB-first expansion semantics confirmed and used via the monochrome path; 2/4-bit expansion branches and raw passthrough cases remain unported

name: Pict_DecodePixmapRows
comment: PICT row decoder: packbits + raw-copy paths, masked-rowBytes 1-byte/BE16 length rule, 1-bit expansion and 8-bit indexed palette output used by PICTs 0x81/0x82/0x8b; depth-0x20 4-component path and output-buffer aliasing details remain out of scope

name: Pict_ParseDirectBitsRect
comment: Opcode walker ported (DAT_00570344 operand table, 0x0001 rect dim override, region/length skips, v2 scan from 0x0011 0x02FF) + BitsRect parse incl. 8-bit indexed ColorTable (sequential ctFlags) and default DAT_005705cc palette; v1 byte-opcode walking and QuickTime 0x8200/0x8201 path TODO(decomp)

name: thunk_Resource_LoadPixPatAsImage
comment: Thunk to Resource_LoadPixPatAsImage (0x0087293e). The port calls the decoder body directly from Resource_LoadPixPatAsImage.

name: ResourceDb_RegisterArchive
comment: Prepend semantics modelled by loading archives oldest-first and walking archives_ in reverse for every lookup, so later archives shadow earlier ones.

name: ResourceData_FindNodeForHandle
comment: Resource-registry handle lookup: walks registry nodes (head DAT_00864f38) to find the owner of a locked block handle; used by ResourceData_ResolveSlotByHandle and ResourceData_ReleaseEntry.

name: NovaProgramEntry
comment: NovaProgramEntry main wrapper; port-only top-level try/catch logs escaped exceptions (original always had a console)

name: MemOrStream_ResolveId
comment: Registry id resolver, provisional: opens the entry for a small-int resource id against a registry root; callers chain it for path resolution (MemOrStream_OpenOrResolvePath 0x004da370).

name: NovaMusic_SwitchBackgroundTrack
comment: Background 'bass' music playback via the vendored dr_mp3 decoder and a dedicated looping SDL audio stream, avoiding an SDL3_mixer/mpg123 LGPL-2.1 runtime dependency.

name: Debug_HandleCheatAndNcbCommands
comment: Cheat-mode arming plus debug NCB condition-test/set-script dialogs; called from Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore and returns the caller's command probe. Renamed in Ghidra from the misleading Mission_TickReactionInputTrigger; unported debug path.

name: DrawContext_SetHyperspaceFlashColor
comment: DrawContext colour setter for the hyperspace flash (3 call sites: Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore arrival 0x0044f729, Stellar_EnterHypergate 0x00456767, Stellar_EnterWormhole 0x00456f27): applies the requested RGB triplet unless the raw g_hyperspace_effects byte is non-zero, in which case it forces black. The port has no DrawContext; the gate is expressed as NovaPrefs_HyperspaceFlashIsBlack (preferences.hpp) resolved by the spaceflight loop into GameState.screen_flash_black, which spaceflight_view.cpp draws as a black vs white full-screen overlay. Preference round-trips via .prf +0x78 already verified.

name: NovaUi_StarmapEnableBordersAction
comment: The Show/Hide Borders action: enables the political overlay and continues the starmap inner loop. Ported inline in NovaStarmap_RunWindow's button switch (case StarmapButton::kShowBorders): toggles GameState::starmap_show_borders (runtime copy of NovaPreferences::starmap_show_borders, .prf +0x76) and rebuilds the overlay.

name: PilotSave_DecodeBlock
comment: DecodePilotBlock leaves plaintext blocks with u16[0] < 0x800 unchanged and otherwise applies the symmetric 0xb36a210f XOR stream from the 0x0046f960 tail call; archived Windows and converted big-endian Mac pilots load through it

name: ResourceArchive_OpenAllRezInNovaFiles
comment: EnsureLoaded opens every case-insensitively sorted *.rez under <install>/Nova Files via EnumerateRezArchives (then the bundled and support Plug-ins layers). DAT_00bec161 install flag not modelled.

name: ResourceArchive_OpenAllRezInNovaPlugins
comment: EnsureLoaded opens every sorted *.rez under <install>/Nova Plug-ins unconditionally (port has no licensing, matching a registered install), falling back to <install>/Plug-ins when Nova Plug-ins is absent (CE Mac-compat fallback, reconfirmed). It then loads the support folder's Nova Plug-ins/*.rez as the strongest layer (port extension). DAT_00bec160 not reproduced.

name: Resource_LoadPixPatAsImage
comment: PixPat decoder: validates patType 1, the PixMap rowBytes flag (0xc000==0x8000), bounds, zero resolution words and depth 1/2/4/8, unpacks MSB-first colour indices with a masked rowBytes stride, and maps the inline ColorTable (count entries, index at +0, RGB low byte at +3/+5/+7) into a 256-colour palette. src/pixpat_image.cpp Resource_LoadPixPatAsImage reproduces it and emits RGBA.

name: NovaUi_ScaleRectInPlace
comment: CE ui_scale helper: multiplies a QuickDraw rect's four shorts by g_ui_scale with x87 half-up rounding. No-op at scale 1.0; port has no ui_scale model.

name: Settings_LoadUiScale
comment: CE-only experimental UI scaling (CE src/scale-dlog.c): reads ddraw.ini [EV Nova] ui_scale (default 1.0, 0 coerced to 1.0), sets g_ui_scale/_is_non_default and rescales five base UI metrics. Unported; the port has no ddraw.ini reader and fixes the HUD strip at 0xC2.

name: Dialog_CreateFromDlog
comment: Reads the DLOG (window bounds + linked DITL id; reimplemented as NovaResource_LoadDialogDefinition) and centres the window on screen (reimplemented as NovaDialogWindow_Layout); Marked 100%: the original global ui-scale canvas path is intentionally replaced; native dialog placement uses each authored composition and SDL placement owns containment and inverse input mapping.

name: PlayerTick_MouseCoordinateBridge
comment: INTERNAL LABEL of 0x0044AA70; not a function. Far bridge adjusts the saved cursor coordinate by the gameplay viewport offset and jumps to 0x0044E019; equivalent coordinate handling is folded into the reimplementation rather than ported one-to-one.
